CONTENT covers all requested areas: (1) CHAIN (§1): the source->verified trace-back spine reproduced from §8 L152-157 (Ads->Live campaign/adset/ad/live_session_id; Live->Comment LIVE_VIEW/LIVE_COMMENT; Comment->Messenger MESSENGER_STARTED/messenger_thread_id; Messenger->Quote AI chi orchestrate/Commerce tao QuoteSnapshot; Quote->Order; Order->Verified) with ownership boundary per hop (M6 measures, Gateway/Commerce own); trace-back requirement L236; PAYMENT_COMPLETED not auto-revenue (M6-OD-008). (2) RESOLVER RESPONSIBILITIES (§2): Ads Context Resolver (campaign/adset/ad/page, entry_channel=FACEBOOK_AD), Live Session Resolver (live/comment/messenger/psid chain, SMK-013, entry_channel=LIVE_ORGANIC, live-signal-never-revenue §18 L362), Attribution Resolver (binds chain->quote/order/ORDER_VERIFIED, sets attribution_window/first_touch/last_touch/referral/diamond/source_confidence/conflict_status), attribution_materializer worker CTR-023 (no verified-revenue overwrite) - every resolver populates ONLY locked §11 fields, invents none, consume-only at edges. (3) CONFIDENCE/CONFLICT (§3): locked enums source_confidence HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW (L233) + conflict_status NONE|MULTI_TOUCH|MISSING_SOURCE|DUPLICATE_RISK (L234); decision table; LOAD-BEARING ASYMMETRY - missing/conflict source => LOW/HOLD => revenue STILL stored but NOT scale evidence (SMK-007/RULE-003 for revenue-retained, L240/RULE-009 for not-scale-evidence); Diamond+Ads => MULTI_TOUCH, full context, Finance decides commission (L238/RULE-019/SMK-014). (4) IMMUTABILITY (§4): mutable until ORDER_VERIFIED then IMMUTABLE, correction = adjustment record {actor,reason,audit,evidence} (L242/RULE-008/SMK-018), materializer never overwrites verified revenue (CTR-023). (5) MULTI-MODEL / M6-OD-005 (§5): dashboard MAY show multiple models but scale gate needs ONE primary (L482 verbatim intent); M6-OD-005 OPEN => scale-model basis BLOCKED, design does NOT pick a model; first_touch/last_touch fields support first/last-touch with existing data, weighted/cohort need NEW data contracts (flagged not built, per RESEARCH_ATTRIBUTION_MODELS M6-P0206).
